title: Greek Rice Pancakes
description: A tasty breakfast dish inspired by Greek cuisine, combining fluffy pancakes with flavorful rice.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the rice, flour, Greek seasoning, salt, and sugar.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the Greek yogurt, eggs, and melted butter.
Gradually add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and mix until smooth.
Heat a non-stick pan or griddle over medium heat.
Using a 1/4 cup measuring cup, scoop the batter onto the pan.
Cook the pancakes for 2-3 minutes on the first side, until bubbles appear on the surface.
Flip the pancakes and cook for another 1-2 minutes, until golden brown.
Serve the pancakes hot with your favorite toppings, such as fresh fruit or honey.
